In England, the name is most commonly found in the south and west of the country, particularly in the counties of Devon and Cornwall. In the United States, the name is more common in the Midwest and Northeast regions. On social media platforms such as Facebook and LinkedIn, the name is used by individuals to identify themselves and connect with others.
